emission_census.scope: Optimization15 actual checked Object exports, both pinned actors; static code and guarded-copy diagnostics only. No linked Object execution or timing observations.

findings: Only exact source masks with same-cell total identity complements qualify. Shape, range, capacity, current private/exclusive bank, identity span and old/scratch disjointness checks remain.
The early current destination!=identity pointer predicate controls complete initialization. Exact equality skips it; the raw stack scratch keeps full capacity.

Map matrix/capture reads retain original source views. Scratch is supplied only as the raw output pointer, and CollectionPush stores selected coordinates. No scratch pointer escapes to a host helper, canonical Value, Rust typed slice or another source matrix.
Selection::cursors and output_index describe the same bounded injective domain for checked evaluation and publication; empty domains perform no scratch reads.

Frame.next stores select(whole_output_initialized,count,0). Standalone maps/folds use None and retain full completion; private selected phase calls ignore the returned local frame. Generic NumericMapFinish independently rejects incomplete success (runtime/collections/numeric_map.rs).

After all checked source evaluation succeeds, current base==identity permits selected-only copy. The other-bank branch requires the initial full-initialization predicate before any destination store. A skipped initialization cannot reach full publication.

No fallible source action/helper occurs after the first publication store. Errors abandon private scratch and replay original execution; source fees, resource caps, source visits and native ABI remain.

An existing dense-map permutation comment describes the full coordinate permutation; the new completion statement explicitly distinguishes selected holes. Safety relies on emitted stores and the selected-domain proof, not that comment.

object_review.source: Actual checked Object emitted by the qualified candidate and accepted48 drivers; not a sampled-process memory capture.
object_review.interpretation: Each equality path branches past its entire16-byte copy loop. Each completion emits zero followed by a pointer comparison and csel of full count only for the different-bank initialized path. Selected publication requires current pointer equality; full copy has the retained initialization guard before its first store. Source widths, complete spans, selected indices and original arithmetic remain proved/checked.
object_review.limitations: Static code is larger because guards/cold paths remain. This establishes actual emitted copy bypass and honest completion, not dynamic copied bytes, retired instructions or a speedup.
